title: fzf: Predictable FIFO path in zsh completion allows local symlink attack / arbitrary file overwrite as the victim user…
description: A vulnerability in fzf's zsh completion script allows local users on multi-user hosts to pre-create a FIFO path in /tmp as a symlink to victim-writable files, causing those files to be overwritten with attacker-influenced content. This can lead to arbitrary file overwrite and potential code execution at the victim's next login. The issue arises because the script uses a predictable FIFO path based on the shell PID and does not properly check the success of removing or creating the FIFO. Kernel protections such as fs.protected_symlinks may block exploitation on modern systems. A fix is available in version 0.74.5.
